text:
maria: Quick sync — follow-up on last week's token validation hiccup. We need owners, deadlines, and a short mitigation path. Root causes were missing audit entries and an expired service token that got reused.
jason: I can own the permissions/audit side. ETA: EOD Wed. I'll run queries and share findings.
sophie: I'll own secrets rotation verification for the ingress-proxy and associated services. Need the exact key IDs that rotated.
devsec-bot: Incident follow-up created: INC-2026-842. Remediation tasks will be tracked in the security tracker.
alex: Can we make this a recurring check? We've seen this pattern twice in the last quarter.
maria: Yes — add a weekly job + alert. @jason can you add a metric for audit log gaps and a dashboard panel?
jason: On it. Planned query: ```SELECT count(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE event='token_validation' AND success IS NULL AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days';``` Will post results and a gist with sample queries.
sophie: Rotation checklist I will use: 1) ensure new KMS envelope for service key, 2) rotate env var in k8s secret, 3) restart pods gracefully, 4) verify validation logs for success. I'll tick items in the tracker per-env.
maria: Confirm owners & deadlines here so we can close the loop: jason — perms/audit (due Wed EOD), sophie — rotation verify (due Thu 12:00), alex — recurring job + alert (due Fri). @devsec-bot, please create tasks with owners and deadlines.
devsec-bot: Tasks created: #842-1 perms-audit (owner:jason, due:2026-04-01), #842-2 rotation-verify (owner:sophie, due:2026-04-02), #842-3 weekly-audit-job (owner:alex, due:2026-04-03).
jason: Posted initial query output in the tracker — 12 missing audit entries for service=ingress-proxy between 2026-03-28 and 2026-03-30. Sample log snippet: ```[2026-03-29T02:14:08Z] ingress-proxy token=*** validation=null ctx=request-id=abc123``` Looks like log emitter dropped for a short window.
sophie: I rotated staging keys and restarted pods; staging shows clean validation logs. Plan: prod rotation tonight at 22:00 PDT with on-call present. Will update the tracker when done.
alex: Drafting Grafana alert: expression audit_log_miss_rate{service="ingress-proxy"} > 0.005 for 5m -> page. PR #1234 opened for infra-as-code. Will link the alert dashboard.
maria: Good progress. Please paste the prod rotation runbook link when ready and tag the change in the tracker. Reconvene next Tue for final sign-off or earlier if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
